query: 'SELECT ViajeId, RutaHistoricaId, VehiculoId, FechaServicio, HoraProgramada, HoraSalida, HoraLlegada, ValidacionesTarjeta, KmRecorridos, EstadoViaje
FROM (
  SELECT
    ViajeId,
    'R-' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(TRY_CAST(REPLACE(TRANSLATE(UPPER(RutaHistoricaId), 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ- ', '############################'), '#', '') AS int) AS varchar(10)), 2) AS RutaHistoricaId,
    RIGHT('00' + CAST(TRY_CAST(REPLACE(TRANSLATE(UPPER(VehiculoId), 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ- ', '############################'), '#', '') AS int) AS varchar(10)), 3) AS VehiculoId,
    CASE WHEN FechaServicio LIKE '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN DATEADD(day, CAST(FechaServicio AS int), '1899-12-30')
         WHEN FechaServicio LIKE '[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9]/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' THEN TRY_CONVERT(date, FechaServicio, 103)
         ELSE TRY_CONVERT(date, LEFT(FechaServicio, 10), 23) END AS FechaServicio,
    CASE WHEN LEN(HoraProgramada) >= 19 THEN SUBSTRING(HoraProgramada, 12, 5) ELSE LEFT(HoraProgramada, 5) END AS HoraProgramada,
    CASE WHEN LEN(HoraSalida) >= 19 THEN SUBSTRING(HoraSalida, 12, 5) ELSE LEFT(HoraSalida, 5) END AS HoraSalida,
    CASE WHEN LEN(HoraLlegada) >= 19 THEN SUBSTRING(HoraLlegada, 12, 5) ELSE LEFT(HoraLlegada, 5) END AS HoraLlegada,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(ValidacionesTarjeta AS int), 0) AS ValidacionesTarjeta,
    COALESCE(TRY_CAST(KmRecorridos AS decimal(9,2)), 0) AS KmRecorridos,
    EstadoViaje,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ViajeId ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS rn
  FROM bronze.ViajesAzure
) t
WHERE rn = 1',

derivedColumn2 derive(FechaServicio = iif(isNull(FechaServicio) || trim(toString(FechaServicio))=='', toDate(null()), iif(regexMatch(trim(toString(FechaServicio)),'^[0-9]{5}$'), addDays(toDate('1899-12-30'), toInteger(trim(toString(FechaServicio)))), coalesce(toDate(left(trim(toString(FechaServicio)),10),'yyyy-MM-dd'), toDate(left(trim(toString(FechaServicio)),10),'dd/MM/yyyy'))))) ~> derivedColumn3
